monitored_text: CNC Manufacturing 4130 Steel Fittings Junying CNC machining 4130 steel fittings/parts/components manufactured by quick machining China supplier – CNClathing.com . Alloy steels 4130 (AISI 4130), is a low alloy steel containing molybdenum and chromium as strengthening agents with low carbon content, easy to weld and can be hardened by heat treatment. It has good formability in the annealed condition, and excellent machinability in the normalized and tempered condition. The CNC manufacturing steel 4130 parts are ideal for structural use, aerospace , oil, gas, automotive, agricultural and defense industries.
